Field
Specification
Case
2025 public-interest action concerning reef blasting and Chinese white dolphin habitat in Weitou Bay [S3]
POV
Fictional environmental NGO field investigator
Threat
Habitat damage, underwater blast impacts, and inadequate environmental assessment

Field evidence collection and environmental-record comparison
Reward
Truth crest piece
Mission

The player investigates reports of reef blasting during the dolphin breeding season. From lawful public viewpoints, they record dates, locations, sightings, and construction activity; interview fishers with consent; compare observations with a simplified environmental assessment; and build a precise evidence package for public-interest action.
Player Flow
Collect observations with timestamp, location, source, and consent information.
Separate what a witness saw from what the witness believes it means.
Overlay dolphin sightings, construction zones, and the assessment's survey area.
Link each claim only to evidence that directly supports it, then submit the package.
Meaningful Choices (leading to negative consequences + remake of choices)
Post or verify? Reliable dates and corroboration matter more than speed.
Trespass for proof? No; use safe, lawful viewpoints and official channels.
Certainty or accurate risk? Strong evidence distinguishes observations, risk, and open questions.

“有些声音，不需要被听见”语义不对，像是在说这些声音不值得听。可改为“有些声音，人类未必听得见”。
“我，在哪”是谁说的完全不清楚；如果是白海豚视角，需要明确声音设计。
“食源”建议改成“食物来源”。
“听着砰的巨响，嘛有人讲……”存在明显错字。
“他们”和“它们”混用。
第2、4页过于密集，像论文而不是制作剧本。
